finalText:
Build now exits 0. The remaining 8 warnings are just deprecation noise from Node/deps (`DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, etc.) plus unrelated lint-style notes — nothing actionable, unlike the two real breakages:

- `src/core/options.js` — still read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now passes `retryCount`, so it threw on `undefined.toFixed`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — treated an unset flag (`undefined`) as invalid and threw, instead of just meaning "disabled."
